reuse.why: Puts the guard in the existing link module beside findOrCreateBank and calls it through the same link.* namespace the link handlers already use.

duplication.why: One guard definition called from each of the five provider link functions; only the provider literal repeats, as the copied link functions already do.

placement.why: link.ts is the tree's home for linking-related DB helpers, so the rule sits in the right layer and is unit-tested there.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, tested, single definition; new providers still have to remember to call it because the link functions themselves remain separate copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link paths go through link.ensureAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: ensureAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by every link*Account in accounts/app.ts.
